adp.meaning_of_absence: No qualifying satellite detection. Does NOT mean there is no haze or smoke.

spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands with the large island in the southeast and the smaller island chain extending northwest. Scattered white cumulus and streaky cirrus clouds cover the western and northern portions and fringe the islands, with large areas of dark open ocean elsewhere. No distinct gray haze or linear smoke-like plume distinguishable from ordinary clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Sporadic lava flows have continued from the north vent over the past day. High fountaining remains a possibility today or anytime within the next few days. Overview: Lava flows have occurred sporadically over the past day from the north vent, at Kīlauea summit.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
